title: Resource utilization of urban sludge via pyrolysis: impacts on cement performance and environmental safety
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4004-4014
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07550E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Fangzhen Hu, Shanjun Zhang, Jing Liu
This work utilizes pyrolysis technology to convert urban sludge into a pyrolyzed sludge at temperatures ranging from 300 °C to 600 °C and investigates its potential application in cement-based materials.
